combos: B, ^B, ^X(7-Koma) - Ichigo slashes twice, followed by his aerial attack. These link easily, and it can be done with >B rather than ^B.

vB, ^X(7-Koma) - Ichigo breaks their guard, which knockes them up into the air in front of you. He then chains them into his aerial attack. This does just as much damage as the chain above, only it takes longer due to the guard break.
Y, ^X(7-Koma) - Ichigo slashes them in a frenzy, hitting for just a bit more damage than the above combos. Don't fully use the Y, only a little will do.

B, >B, Y, ^Y, Aerial Y - Ichigo slashes them up into the air, which is followed by a flashstepped slash, linking into a flashstep to the ground, where he'll slash them onto their back. Hits for a good amount of damage.
B, >B, Y(only one tap), >Y - Ichigo slashes them fowards and back again.
unresolved: Koma tree diagram shows Help feeding into two support Koma (2, 3) and five battle Koma (4-8), but the guide never gives HP values for any koma size.
The 3-Koma support description says it is 'shaped as [][] / []' — schema field for koma shape/size is just a number; the visual shape note doesn't fit any field.

The guide states damage pairs as '(Power/Laughter) (Knowledge)' for the 4-6 Koma table but does not clarify whether Bankai (7-8 Koma) damage pairs follow the same nature-column convention; assumed same format.
5-Koma ^X and 6-Koma ^X give no damage numbers (they are buff moves), consistent with no direct damage, but the guide doesn't explicitly say 'no damage.'
Up Y for Bankai (7-8 Koma) gives no damage number at all, unlike its non-Bankai counterpart.

The author is unsure of a support Koma character's name: 'Satsuki(?  Anyone who submits name gets credit)' for the 2-Koma health-regen support — kept as written in Supports section, not modeled in schema since it's another character's koma, not Ichigo's.
Guide format has a typo/garbled line break: '^Y: ... 15 damage, 22 damage/' and '9 damage, 13 damage/' — trailing slash appears to be an OCR/formatting artifact, kept in quotes as written.

The Supports section describes support Koma belonging to OTHER characters (Shishio, Hitsugaya, Trunks, Sena, Gyro, Yahiko, etc.) that pair well with Ichigo — these are not Ichigo's own koma and are not included in the koma array, only referenced in this unresolved note for completeness.

'Playing as Ichigo' section (teleport-dash ability, recommended help Koma pairings like Piccolo/Orochimaru for HP regen or Yusuke for energy regen) is general strategy advice, not a specific move/koma stat, so not modeled in the schema.
The guide never states whether the 4-6 Koma have distinct HP values from each other or from the 7-8 Koma; no HP numbers are given anywhere in the guide.
